title: Yam the Pig
lines: Tom has a pet pig. It is Yam.
Yam is big. Yam can run a lot.
Tom lets Yam sit on the rug.
But Yam is not fed yet.
Yam gets up. Yam runs at the pot.
The pot tips. Nuts hit the rug.
Tom is mad. But Yam is not sad yet.
Yam naps on the rug. Tom gets a rag.
Tom can not be mad at Yam.

questions.ask: Why did Yam run at the pot?
questions.listenFor: Because Yam had not been fed yet and the nuts were in the pot. If they say "he was hungry," ask them to find the line that tells us.

questions.ask: What did Tom get at the end, and why?
questions.listenFor: A rag, because the nuts and the pot made a mess on the rug. The why is not spelled out, so it is fine to work it out together.

questions.ask: Do you think Yam is a good pet? Tell me why you think so.
questions.listenFor: No wrong answer. You want a reason from the story - Yam took the nuts, or Yam naps sweetly on the rug. Reasons matter more than the yes or no.
